tasks.personal-social-wellbeing-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering puberty, emotions, HIV and AIDS awareness, community service, and career awareness. Emphasise respectful language about change, supportive responses, facts that challenge stigma, and links between strengths, community roles, and future goals.
tasks.physical-education-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering team games, fitness circuits, coordination review, recreation, and health. Emphasise combining movement skills in games and stations, fair play, safe participation, self-assessment, and the health benefits of regular physical activity.
tasks.creative-arts-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering 3D construction, design planning, dance-drama integration, and final presentation. Emphasise planning a model or sculpture, choosing and joining materials, balance and texture, rehearsal, teamwork, showcase preparation, portfolio evidence, and peer feedback.
